findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：競爭者（含非傳統參與者如雜貨即食餐、餐盒、幽靈廚房、外送平台）同樣主張高品質原料、無人工添加，可能削弱 CMG 差異化。
findings.excerpt: many of our competitors also make claims related to the quality of their ingredients and lack of artificial flavors, colors and preservatives. The use of these claims by competitors, even if such claims are not accurate or comparable, may lessen our differentiation and make it more difficult for us to compete.
